Our Business Model

  • FLEXIBLE ENGAGEMENT - Every business has unique operational requirements. That's why we offer flexible engagement models designed to align with your workload, objectives, and budget.
  • PER HOUR - Pay only for the support hours you need. A flexible option for businesses with varying call volumes and seasonal demand.
  • MONTHLY CONTRACT - Benefit from dedicated operational support through a fixed monthly engagement, ensuring consistency, reliability, and long-term partnership.
  • TRANSPARENT PRICING - No hidden fees, unexpected costs, or complicated billing structures. We provide clear pricing, competitive rates, and complete transparency from day one.
SLA PROMISE
  • HIGH AVAILABILITY - Dependable support backed by a 99.9% service availability commitment, ensuring uninterrupted business operations.
  • RESPONSE TIME - Prompt handling of customer inquiries and operational requests to help maintain service excellence and business continuity.
  • QUALITY ASSURANCE - Structured quality monitoring processes ensure every interaction meets professional standards and client expectations.
  • PERFORMANCE -Continuous performance tracking, reporting, and process optimization designed to deliver measurable results and ongoing improvement.

Message From The CEO

At Prime Fleet Services, we understand that exceptional service is the foundation of every successful transportation business. In an industry where every call, reservation, and customer interaction matters, our mission is to help transportation companies deliver seamless experiences while operating more efficiently.

With over 18 years of experience in customer service, business operations, lead generation, and outsourcing solutions, I have witnessed how the right support systems can transform businesses. That's why Prime Fleet Services was built—to provide reliable dispatch, reservation management, and customer support solutions that help our clients focus on growth while we handle the operational demands.

Our commitment is simple: professionalism, reliability, and service excellence in every interaction. We strive to become a trusted extension of your team, helping you enhance customer satisfaction, improve operational efficiency, and create lasting business success.

Thank you for considering Prime Fleet Services as your operational support partner. We value your trust and look forward to contributing to your continued growth and success.
